posts.description: Let $p = (p_1, \dots, p_V)^\top$ with $p_i \ge 0$ and $\sum_i p_i=1$ be a categorical probability distribution over a vocabulary of size $V$. We draw $N$ i.i.d. samples from $p$ to form the empirical probability vector $\hat p$, which should be close to $p$. If we draw again, the two empirical probability vectors should also be close. posts.title: GPT-OSS Model
posts.description: GPT-OSS is an open source, open weight model by OpenAI with Apache 2.0 license. It is an autoregressive mixture-of-experts (MoE) model that specialized in reasoning (chain of thought), tool use, and support structured output. Similar to Llama architecture, it uses pre-norm with RMS norm and each expert is a SwiGLU-based MLP.
